Reviewer: skull pool job review-4363, Claude Fable 5.2, mkinney / mike seat; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: ready for a maintainer to merge.** No blocking finding. This is a safety-tier review, because the PR changes posted G-code.

Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4363#issuecomment-7218744315

## What looks good

- `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:1123` and `:1146`: the `!inCycle` guard is the same test that `chainCut()` uses. Outside a cycle group the output does not change.
- `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:951-954`: `G80` now comes before `disableSmoothing()`. `restorePlane()` and `ensureProbeOff()` keep their position.
- I read each caller of `enableSmoothing()`. After this change, smoothing cannot be active while `inCycle` is true: `onCycle` calls `disableSmoothing()` before each of its return paths, and `startPreamble` runs only with `inCycle` false.
- After a hop rapid writes `G80`, the next cutting move arms smoothing again. That order is correct.
- The PR changes three files. No `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file is in the diff. "Goldens moved: none" is correct.
- The body is complete: cause, old and new output, pin, mutation, `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #4347`. The decision record is in `docs/decisions/4347-dnm-smoothing-cycle.md`.
- The body says which guards have no pin of their own. That statement is accurate (see the mutations).

## Results, trial merge with main

Built locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-4363`. The tree is head `3484c8b3b` merged with upstream/main `79f4dbe4a`. The merge was clean.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test doosan_dnm_post` | 10 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 73 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled |

The quick gate included these steps, all green:

- `post suites: doosan_dnm_post`, `script_doosan_dnm`, `cycle_hop`, `fanuc_aicc`
- `app suites: conformance`
- `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`
- `app suites: doosan_dnm_a_state`

Extra suites run: none are owed. The diff changes no file under `testdata/`, no golden directory and no import code.

Heavy lanes: not run. This is a `P3` PR, and the heavy lanes are not a review condition.

## Mutations (run by the reviewer)

1. `onLinear`: I put `enableSmoothing();` back without the guard. The pin `doosan_dnm_smoothing_stays_out_of_open_cycle_group` failed with "no G5.1 word inside the open cycle group". The program had `G5.1 Q1 R5` and `G5.1 Q0` between `G81` and `G80`. At the section end it had `G80`, then `G5.1 Q0`. This confirms the statement in the body about the `endPreamble` order.
2. `endPreamble` and `onCircular`: I put the old order and the old `onCircular` line back, with the `onLinear` guard in place. The suite stayed green (10 passed). These two changes are second guards without a pin of their own, as the body says.

I restored the file after each mutation. The worktree is clean at the reviewed head.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:1146`: the `onCircular` guard has no pin. A stream with an arc on the hole inside an open group can pin it. No generator writes such a stream today, so this is `P7` at most.
- `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:915` and `:1295`: a section that only drills still writes `G5.1 Q1 R5` in its preamble and `G5.1 Q0` before `G81`. This output is legal and was there before this PR. A later change can stop the pair. Suggested `P7`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
